test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rock shelters of Bhimbetka is famous for which of the following?

options.text: Traces of sculpture of the Mughals
Traces of paintings during the Maurya dynasty
Traces of the early Dravidian period
Earliest traces of human life on the Indian subcontinent

solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Earliest traces of human life on the Indian subcontinent.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Rock Shelters of Bhimbetka**

__
 
• An **archaeological site in central India **that spans the **Paleolithic, Mesolithic periods and** **historic period**.
 
• It exhibits the **earliest traces of human life in India**
 
• It is the evidence of **Stone Age starting at the site in Acheulian times.**
 
• One of the** oldest-known rock art in India **and **largest prehistoric complexes.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Bhimbetka has around** 243 rock shelters and have earned the honour of UNESCO World Heritage Site.**
 
• **Wakankar** had discovered **700-odd rock shelters**, spread over a **10-km area in Bhimbetka.**
 
• Located in the** Raisen District in the Indian state of Madhya Pradesh about 45 kilometres south-east of Bhopal. **
 
• It also contain **fossils from the Precambrian, hundreds of millions of years before the human era, including the enigmatic basal animal Dickinsonia.**
